sentences: If you're heading for your nearest branch of Waterstones, the biggest book retailer in the UK, in search of the Duchess of Sussex's new children's book The Bench, you might have to be prepared to hunt around a bit; the same may be true of The President's Daughter, the new thriller by Bill Clinton and James Patterson.
Both of these books are published next week by Penguin Random House (PRH), a company currently involved in a stand-off with Waterstones.
translations: 如果你正前往英国最大的图书零售商Waterstones最近的分店，寻找苏塞克斯公爵夫人的新儿童书《长凳》，你可能得准备好稍微找一找；比尔·克林顿和詹姆斯·帕特森的新惊悚小说《总统的女儿》可能也是如此。
这两本书都将于下周由企鹅兰登书屋（PRH）出版，该公司目前正与Waterstones陷入僵局。

sentences: The problem began late last year, when PRH confirmed that it had introduced a credit limit with Waterstones "at a very significant level".

The trade magazine The Bookseller reported that Waterstones branch managers were being told to remove PRH books from prominent areas such as tables, display spaces and windows, and were "quietly retiring them to their relevant sections".
translations: 问题始于去年年底，当时PRH确认已对Waterstones实施了“非常显著水平”的信用额度。
行业杂志《书商》报道称，Waterstones的分店经理被告知要将PRH的书籍从桌子、展示空间和窗户等显眼位置移除，并“悄悄地将它们退回到相应的区域”。

sentences: PRH declined to comment on the issue, but a spokesperson for Waterstones told me: "Waterstones are currently operating with reduced credit terms from PRH, the only publisher in the UK to place any limitations on our ability to trade.
We are not boycotting PRH titles but we are doing our utmost to ensure that availability for customers remains good despite the lower overall levels of stock.
We are hopeful with our shops now open again that normality will return and that we will be allowed to buy appropriately.
Certainly, our shops are exceptionally busy.
The sales for our May Books of the Month surpassed any month since 2018."
translations: PRH拒绝就此事发表评论，但Waterstones的一位发言人告诉我：“Waterstones目前正以PRH缩减的信用条款运营，PRH是英国唯一一家对我们交易能力施加限制的出版商。
我们并未抵制PRH的图书，但尽管整体库存水平较低，我们仍竭尽全力确保顾客的可得性保持良好。
随着我们的门店重新开业，我们希望一切能恢复正常，并且我们能获准适量采购。
当然，我们的门店异常繁忙。
我们五月月度之书的销售额超过了自2018年以来的任何一个月。”

sentences: In the meantime, PRH authors have been the losers.

Big-name PRH authors may suffer a bit, but it's those mid-list authors, who normally rely on Waterstones staff's passion for promoting books by lesser-known writers, who will be praying for an end to the dispute.
translations: 与此同时，PRH的作者们成了输家。
PRH的大牌作者可能会受些影响，但正是那些中层作者——他们通常依赖Waterstones员工对推广不知名作家书籍的热情——将会祈祷这场争端结束。

sentences: It comes at a time when authors are already worried about the consequences of the proposed merger between PRH and another big publisher, Simon & Schuster—the reduction in the number of unaligned UK publishers is likely to lead to fewer bidding wars, lower advances, and more conformity in terms of what is published.
translations: 这正值作者们已经担忧PRH与另一家大出版商西蒙与舒斯特拟议合并的后果之际——英国独立出版商数量的减少可能导致竞标战减少、预付款降低，以及出版内容更加趋同。

sentences: "This is all part of a wider change towards concentration of power," says literary agent Andrew Lownie.
"The publishing industry talks about diversity in terms of authors and staff but it also needs a plurality of ways of delivering intellectual contact, choice and different voices.
After all, many of the most interesting books in recent years have come from small publishers."
translations: “这都是权力集中这一更广泛变革的一部分，”文学经纪人安德鲁·朗尼说。
“出版业在谈论作者和员工的多样性，但它也需要多种方式来提供思想接触、选择和不同的声音。
毕竟，近年来许多最有趣的书籍都来自小型出版商。”

sentences: We shall see whether that plurality is a casualty of the current need among publishers to be big enough to take on all-comers.
translations: 我们将拭目以待，这种多样性是否会成为出版商当前需要足够强大以应对所有竞争者的牺牲品。

sentences:
31. The author mentions two books in Paragraph 1 to present
A. an ongoing conflict
B. an intellectual concept
C. a prevailing sentiment
D. a literary phenomenon
translations:
31. 作者在第一段提到两本书是为了呈现
A. 一场持续的冲突
B. 一个知识概念
C. 一种普遍情绪
D. 一种文学现象

sentences:
32. Why did Waterstones shops retire PRH books to their relevant sections?
A. To make them easily noticeable.
B. To comply with PRH's requirement.
C. To respond to PRH's business move.
D. To arrange them in a systematic way.
translations:
32. 为什么Waterstones书店将PRH的书籍退回到相应的区域？
A. 为了使它们容易被注意到。
B. 为了遵守PRH的要求。
C. 为了回应PRH的商业举措。
D. 为了系统地安排它们。

sentences:
33. What message does the spokesperson for Waterstones seem to convey?
A. Their customers remain loyal
B. The credit limit will be removed
C. Their stock is underestimated
D. The book market is rather slack
translations:
33. Waterstones的发言人似乎在传达什么信息？
A. 他们的顾客仍然忠诚
B. 信用额度将被取消
C. 他们的库存被低估了
D. 图书市场相当萧条

sentences:
34. What can be one consequence of the current dispute?
A. Sales of books by mid-list PRH writers fall off considerably
B. Lesser-known PRH writers become the target of criticism
C. Waterstones staff hesitate to promote big-name authors' books
D. Waterstones branches suffer a severe reduction in revenue.
translations:
34. 当前争端的一个后果可能是什么？
A. PRH中层作家的书籍销量大幅下降
B. 不知名的PRH作家成为批评的目标
C. Waterstones员工犹豫是否推广知名作家的书籍
D. Waterstones分店的收入严重减少。

sentences:
35. Which of the following statements best represents Lownie's view?
A. Small publishers ought to stick together.
B. Big publishers will lose their dominance.
C. The publishing industry is having a hard time.
D. The merger of publishers is a worrying trend.
translations:
35. 以下哪项陈述最能代表朗尼的观点？
A. 小型出版商应该团结一致。
B. 大型出版商将失去其主导地位。
C. 出版业正面临困难时期。
D. 出版商的合并是一个令人担忧的趋势。
